extraction: Film data and Natural Earth TopoJSON extracted without executing supplied page scripts. Geography rasterized offline into equirectangular textures; no D3, TopoJSON, remote font, OrbitControls or duplicate Three renderer required.
film_content_verification: User-supplied film/location/visiting content retained; not independently fact-checked. Visiting status is source content, not current travel guidance.
poster_fields: All 200 source poster fields are blank. bookCover uses the existing library asset only for exact title + year matches.
map_detail: Rasterized from supplied vector map. The 4096 export is map rendering resolution, not photographic Earth detail.
map_style: Blue oceans, parchment country tint, graticule, country boundaries and internal US state boundaries. Antarctica excluded to match source rendering.
sphere_uv: Three SphereGeometry; x=cos(latitude)*cos(longitude), y=sin(latitude), z=-cos(latitude)*sin(longitude). Texture x=(longitude+180)/360; y=(90-latitude)/180.
